programme.title: Cintaku Di Kejar Cicilan
programme.desc: Andre adalah pria tampan yang selalu bergaya dengan barang-barang mewah. Namun, semua itu dibeli Andre dengan berutang, akhirnya dia pun dikejar cicilan yang menumpuk.

programme.title: Putri Langit Cari Jodoh
programme.desc: Anjani adalah putri khayangan yang diturunkan ke bumi selama 100 hari untuk mencari pemuda sebagai calon suami. Sebelum turun ke bumi, Anjani dibekali kalung yang menjadi sumber kekuatannya.

programme.title: Toko Kr.Amat Sepeda Onthel Badai
programme.desc: Guntur berencana membeli sepeda ontel di toko Kr.Amat yang katanya bisa melaju secepat cahaya hanya dengan sekali kayuh. Terbukti ketika Guntur mengayuh pedal tiba-tiba sepeda itu melesat sangat kencang lalu lenyap dalam sekejap.

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Dompet
programme.desc: Tak ingin diledek jomblo terus, Kinan berpura-pura menjadi pacar Reno yang tajir, namun Reno hanya memanfaatkan Kinan saja. Ternyata Reno tidak setajir yang Kinan kira.

programme.title: Prajurit Bantegan
programme.desc: Igo pindah dari kota besar setelah kedua orang tuanya meninggal. Saat mendapat masalah dengan pemilik sanggar bantengan, dia bertemu Ki Sungkur yang menolongnya. Sejak itu dia berguru silat kepada Ki Sungkur.

programme.title: Stalker With Love
programme.desc: Sania kabur ke desa untuk mencari Adi kekasihnya yang tiba-tiba menghilang. Kaburnya Sania tentu saja membuat terkejut kedua orang tua Sania, segala daya upaya pun dilakukan untuk mencarinya.

programme.title: Factory Cinta
programme.desc: Karin melaksanakan tugas KKN di sebuah desa terpencil selama dua minggu. Merasa bosan, dia dan sahabatnya, Dinda, pergi ke kota untuk berbelanja tapi justru kemalingan dan tersesat. Lalu, Aman datang menyelamatkannya.

programme.title: Terdampar Di Pulau Kosong
programme.desc: Tomi mengajak teman-teman sekelas liburan di sebuah pulau.Tomi ajak Hani jalan-jalan dengan speedboat. Ditengah laut speedboat hilang kendali. Tomi menyelamatkan diri sendiri dan Hani ditinggal terdampar di pulau tak berpenghuni.

programme.title: Toko Kr.Amat Kamera Masa Lalu
programme.desc: Jack, seorang detektif junior ditugaskan menyelidiki kasus pencurian. Ketika menuju lokasi Jack lupa membawa kamera, terpaksa ia mencari kamera hingga berhenti di sebuah toko benda antik dan membeli kamera.

programme.title: Cinta Ditolak Disko Bertindak
programme.desc: Inilah lika-liku persahabatan Mila dan Zani, dua gadis yang berlawanan pandangan soal ramalan. Tidak hanya kekonyolan, kisah ini juga menghadirkan perjuangan keduanya meraih asmara.

programme.title: Ketukan Yang Mengancam
programme.desc: Aris, Novi dan Danu adalah sahabat dekat sejak SMP. Setelah tanpa sengaja menguping pembicaraan tentang meja kayu tua misterius di gudang sekolah yang bisa memanggil arwah, mereka berniat membuktikannya.

programme.title: Ku Jahit Cinta Dengan Bismillah
programme.desc: Lila adalah anak yatim yang bekerja sebagai penjahit. Saat sedang mengantarkan hasil jahitan, dia menabrak motor Robby. Sebagai ganti rugi, Lila harus berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya. Seiring waktu berjalan, tumbuh rasa cinta

programme.title: Goyang Pinguin
programme.desc: Selvi dan Eriska yang dulunya bukan apa-apa namun sekarang menjadi sukses.Sayang sekali karier dan persahabatan mereka terganggu karena keduanya menyukai lelaki yang sama. Ternyata, lelaki tersebut telah dijodohkan dengan Eriska.

programme.title: Yuk Kita Sholat
programme.desc: Sally adalah idola kampus yang diperebutkan oleh Sam dan Sony. Sementara Sally hanya menyukai Bambang. Akhirnya Sam dan Sony meminta bantuan dukun untuk mengirim santet. hingga Bambang meninggal dunia.

programme.title: Saka Si Manusia Ikan
programme.desc: Seorang gadis yang kehilangan ayahnya karena ditarik ke dalam air oleh manusia ikan. Ternyata gadis itu terpesona oleh ketampanan si manusia ikan.Maukah sang gadis mengorbankan kehidupannya selama ini demi orang yang dia sayangi?

programme.title: Putri Salju Van Betawi
programme.desc: Puteri, seorang gadis yang dibuang dan akan dibunuh oleh Ibu tirinya. Dia akhirnya dibesarkan oleh seorang jawara betawi yang melatihnya menjadi seorang gadis pesilat handal yang akan menghadapi sang Ibu tiri dan pasukannya

programme.title: Cinta Ditolak Disko Bertindak
programme.desc: Inilah lika-liku persahabatan Mila dan Zani, dua gadis yang berlawanan pandangan soal ramalan. Tidak hanya kekonyolan, kisah ini juga menghadirkan perjuangan keduanya meraih asmara.

programme.title: Pacar Dari Langit
programme.desc: Karena ayahnya sakit. Mega terpaksa pulang ke kampung halaman dan jatuh cinta kepada alien bernama Zen. yang berjanji akan selalu menjaganya.

programme.title: Kasih Tak Santai
programme.desc: Kemal dan Ranti adalah sepasang kekasih yang rupawan dan trendi. Ketika Kemal berkunjung ke rumah Ranti, ayahnya dan ibu Ranti yang sama-sama sedang puber kedua, menunjukkan tanda kasmaran.Akankah ini berdampak buruk untuk Kemal?

programme.title: Ketemu Cinta Di Online Shop
programme.desc: Rayya adalah mahasiswa yang menekuni bisnis online. Dia mendapat saingan yaitu Pras, teman kampusnya yang juga punya bisnis toko online. Setelah kalah bersaing, Pras bekerja untuk Rayya, dan mereka saling jatuh cinta.

programme.title: Mencari Pangeran Sepatu Basket
programme.desc: Miranda trauma dengan pria, hubungannya selalu gagal dan dia selalu dikecewakan. Untuk mengobati hati, Miranda pergi liburan dengan kapal pesiar. Tak di sangka di kapal pesiar itu Miranda justru berkenalan dengan Ibas.

programme.title: Janda Janda Jagoan
programme.desc: Maya, Anggi, dan Sindy adalah tiga perempuan jagoan yang berstatus janda. Mereka menjadi incaran penjahat. Vina, anak Anggi diculik oleh penjahat itu. Dapatkah tiga jagoan ini membebaskan Vina?

programme.title: Dari Nada Turun Ke Hati
programme.desc: Prisa, seorang mahasiswi baru jurusan musik, sedang berusaha mencari partitur lagu yang akan dimainkannya saat Ujian Akhir Semester. Dia pun berangkat ke sebuah perpustakaan musik dan bertemu Edwin.

programme.title: PDKT Berbahaya
programme.desc: Untuk mendekati Alin, Egi memaksa teman-temannya, Sony dan Amanda, untuk berlibur ke kampung halaman Alin. Dalam perjalanan menuju kesana mereka memutuskan untuk melewati jalan terlarang, dan mengalami banyak kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Toko Kr.Amat Gelang Tulang
programme.desc: Berawal dari kesusahan yang mendera keluarganya Ratu dan Panji mencuri sepasang gelang tulang yang dapat menembus benda padat sesuai kehendak mereka. Namun mereka tak menyadari bahwa gelang tulang itu membawa petaka.

programme.title: Telur Asin Cap Cinta
programme.desc: Tanpa sengaja Dhira merusak ponsel Cindy, dia pun bingung karena dia juga punya utang kepada orang lain. Akhirnya dia memutuskan berjualan telur asin.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The monk Hung Wen-Ting fights against the evil priest White Lotus.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Ti Lung who lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with his brothers the Black Snake and the Yellow Snake, have been trying to turn into humans for a thousand years.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: A group of young elite commandos, led by Captain Drummond are tasked with collecting highly classified information that can change the fate of the war.

programme.title: Return Of The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Sequel to the John Lo Mar/Chang Yang original finds immigrant Yeh Feng leaving jail to live with crooked uncle Wang Sha, but his girlfriend Ai Ti has married an abusive husband.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: Assassin Chang and his brother Hung meet up with a soldier, Mu. Together, they form a small mountain army, but when Hung's wife arrives, emotions swell, and Mu leaves for the army. After long, Mu summons his friends to join him, but all the while, he has longed for Hung's wife, and tries to have Hung murdered. This treason forces Hung to take up arms against his former comrade.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Ching Feng-Hsiao disguises herself as male to enroll for the imperial examination in order to save her lover from being framed by her stepmother. Can she make it?

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: 6 swordsmen, among them 2 sisters and their husbands, a lone ranger and a security guard, plot, betray and outwit each other for a load of gold.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This film showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of three girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: A master gambler loses his memory and is befriended by a street hustler who discovers his supernatural gambling abilities.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Legendary actress Lin Feng Jiao stars in this romantic comedy as an unlikely romance occurs between an entrepreneur's son and a kindergarten's principal's niece.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Millionaire Chu Te-Sa (Chiang) invests his considerable wealth into the rebel movement who are intent on usurping the ruling Mongol powers. His goals are impeded by a lack of support though and the supposed allies he has made in the town are merely eager to get their hands on his money. During an attack where these craven 'comrades' flee, Chu befriends three con-artists who relish the chance to show off their fighting skills. The trio subsequently agree to help Chu in his quest to end Mongol rule and hatch a plan to destroy a major munitions dump.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: Three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls journey north to masquerade as high society debutantes and make their dreams of a gold-plated walk down the aisle come true.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Kuo Tsing wins the hand of fair maiden Huang Yung. Almost immediately, however, clan rivalries leads to Kuo being wounded by Ouyang Feng and Huang being named new leader of the Beggar Clan.

programme.title: Big Times For Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: The crazy bumpkins return for the third time! Ah Niu is minding his own business when a bag of jewels falls from the sky. And that's just the beginning of a series of misadventures!

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: The tale of a noble swordsman and a one-armed swordswoman who find themselves up against the evil Crimson Charm gang of thieves and thugs.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: This is a tragic tale about a young girl, played by Ivy Ling Po, who gets married and has five kids. She and her husband later die, forcing one child to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

programme.title: To Kill A Jaguar
programme.desc: To Kill A Jaguar

programme.title: Clans Of Intrigue
programme.desc: One day, when the heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, Gong from the Holy Water Palace accuses Chu of stealing the holy water and using it for various murders.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Bai Yu Lung's father mysteriously disappears one night, and for 10 years Bai searches for him in vain. Finally, he decides to head to the far northern part of the country with the hope that he can find a clue in that region.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: Set in the Han Dynasty, a gang of loyalists led by Yang Chi-ching and Lin Dai, strive to drive a wedge between the governor and his son, eventually turning them against each other.

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Black Butterfly, steals from the rich and gives to the poor. In reality, she is Bao Zhu, the daughter of retired swordsman Kwan Yee. Trouble starts when a bandit gang who she has robbed come to town looking for her.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Set on the eve of the Japanese invasion of HK, this tragic Shaw Brothers romance stars Li Ting and Kwan Shan as young lovers torn apart by war.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: The emperor's reign of terror expands. Heroic outlaw Ma Teng joins a squad of female rebels, whose leader is torn between family loyalties.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This film is a coming-of-age tale of the lower-class Hong Kong teens in the 1960s. Wang is the title character, a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: Stephen Chow leaves for the big city to try and save his home by winning the huge snooker tournament.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Taoist Priest isn't happy when his Buddhist Priest colleague moves in next door. They are subject to feuds and duels, but soon must overcome their problems when a vampire breaks loose from his coffin and wreaks havoc to the countryside.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish and discovers that it is Chi who captures them.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This film tells the story of a Chinese illegal immigrant, Cheung Kwan-chow, and his journey in New York.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Action adventure in which the formula for a cancer-curing medicine is stolen, and a kung-fu fighting team must overcome rivals and doublecrosses in order to get it back

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. Things change, when Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man at Tamotsu's funeral.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A regime shift in Leka stirs chaos. Police send undercover Zheng Zha into Song Bang’s gang, unaware others are waiting to strike back and settle old scores.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: A man received a haunted mail predicting his death. A man mourns the death of his beloved wife. Three brothers clashes over dinner.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: Security guard Lee Go is assigned to keep guard at a house while the owner is away. However, a series of hilarious misunderstandings occur.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: A washed-up writer forms an unlikely friendship with a teenager from Long Island.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father is exposed.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: The film revolves around a woman in her late twenties who rediscovers her talent for boxing after a long hiatus. She unexpectedly meets her former boxing coach and the pair work together to help her reach the final rounds of professional boxing matches.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Ruthless gangster Guts pulls off a heist of diamonds, then enlists the aid of longtime triad member, Fei, to arrange a buyer for them. But when Guts double crosses the buyer, Fei ends up with the diamonds, wanted by both the cops and Guts.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: A frustrated young man afflicted with polio works as a paralegal for a corrupt lawyer. He gets passed onto him the technique for a strange power by a dying man, which turns him into an oil based superhero/villain.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: A fantasy-horror set in present-day Moscow where the respective forces that control daytime and nighttime do battle.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh 2
programme.desc: The cheating husband goes bankrupt, and his house is soon to be taken by the government. A security guard is assigned to guard it while the husband goes missing. However, only the mistress stays alone in the house. Will the lonely, handsome guard and the heartbroken mistress hook up?

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: As a man leaves his wife and daughter, a series of brief conversations, observed gestures, chance encounters and impulsive acts, tell the story of the relationships that flounder and thrive in the wake of this decision.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl. But Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap.

programme.title: Fist Of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: A rich old man and a sexy young photographer compete for a stunning young gym instructor. The younger man is clearly winning until the rich man offers a deal.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: For five years, 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete Toyota AE86 every morning and because of that, he has become a good racer and also unwillingly perfected the art of drifting.

Starting from scratch, she and her husband began creating short videos, exploring rural areas to find inheritors of intangible cultural heritage.

programme.title: Beijing Daxing Int'l..., Ep 3
programme.desc: In 3 days, Beijing Daxing International Airport will face a pressure test - its biggest challenge before going into operation. Everyone is busy preparing for it. programme.title: Legend Of Mining And..., Ep 1
programme.desc: In 1973, a discovery was made beneath Tonglu Mountain in China’s Hubei Province: 13 bronze axe-heads made thousands of years ago. programme.title: Oskar And Lilli: Where No One Knows Us
programme.desc: Kakak beradik asal Chechnya, Oskar dan Lilli, menghadapi deportasi dari Austria, namun terpisah di panti asuhan setelah percobaan bunuh diri yang dilakukan ibu mereka.

programme.title: The Salvation Of The World As We Know It
programme.desc: Setelah percobaan bunuh diri, Paul yang berusia 17 tahun dikirim ke pusat kejiwaan oleh ayahnya. Di sana, ia bertemu dengan para pemuda lain yang memiliki masalah yang sama dengannya, salah satunya adalah Toni.

programme.title: Pak Guru Huruf G Nya Pasti Dari Galak
programme.desc: Bagus adalah seorang guru yang sudah lama ditinggal meninggal oleh istrinya. Bagus hidup bersama anaknya yang cantik, Siska. Tanpa Bagus ketahui, diam-diam Siska disukai oleh Gerry. Siska pun menyukai Gerry hingga mereka memutuskan untuk pacaran.Namun, Bagus yang merupakan guru di sekolah Siska, tidak suka dengan kedekatan Siska dan Gerry karena menurutnya anaknya masih kecil. Pada suatu hari, tanpa sengaja motor Bagus dan Gerry tabrakan. Bagus kaget saat mengetahui bahwa Gerry dan Siska dekat. Di sisi lain Bagus yang sudah duda coba buat mendekati Indri, guru cantik di sekolah Siska. Namun, Siska kesal karena Bagus menyetujui hubungannya dengan diri, tapi malah mendekati Indri.

programme.title: Ditiup Kamu Bikin Cenat-Cenut
programme.desc: Bastian adalah seorang cowok manja yang baru jatuh miskin karena perusahaan keluarganya bangkrut. Ia pun sedang mencari pekerjaan. Pada suatu hari, tanpa sengaja Bastian menabrak Maesaroh yang sedang berjalan dan membawa wadah makanan. Bastian dengan sigap membantu Maesaroh hingga wadah makanannya tidak berantakan. Tanpa sengaja, Bastian dan Maesaroh berpelukan. Maesaroh yang merupakan gadis asli Betawi dan menyukai tanjidor karena itu adalah warisan babehnya, mengajak Bastian bergabung di grup tanjidor miliknya. Bastian pun setuju dan mau bekerja di tempat Maesaroh. Sejak saat itu, Bastian dan Maesaroh pun menjadi dekat dan lengket. Padahal, Bastian dan Maesaroh sudah dijodohkan oleh ibu mereka masing-masing dengan anak orang kaya, tapi keduanya menolak.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Pak Guru Huruf G Nya Pasti Dari Galak
programme.desc: Bagus adalah seorang guru yang sudah lama ditinggal meninggal oleh istrinya. Bagus hidup bersama anaknya yang cantik, Siska. Tanpa Bagus ketahui, diam-diam Siska disukai oleh Gerry. Siska pun menyukai Gerry hingga mereka memutuskan untuk pacaran.Namun, Bagus yang merupakan guru di sekolah Siska, tidak suka dengan kedekatan Siska dan Gerry karena menurutnya anaknya masih kecil. Pada suatu hari, tanpa sengaja motor Bagus dan Gerry tabrakan. Bagus kaget saat mengetahui bahwa Gerry dan Siska dekat. Di sisi lain Bagus yang sudah duda coba buat mendekati Indri, guru cantik di sekolah Siska. Namun, Siska kesal karena Bagus menyetujui hubungannya dengan diri, tapi malah mendekati Indri.

programme.title: Ditiup Kamu Bikin Cenat-Cenut
programme.desc: Bastian adalah seorang cowok manja yang baru jatuh miskin karena perusahaan keluarganya bangkrut. Ia pun sedang mencari pekerjaan. Pada suatu hari, tanpa sengaja Bastian menabrak Maesaroh yang sedang berjalan dan membawa wadah makanan. Bastian dengan sigap membantu Maesaroh hingga wadah makanannya tidak berantakan. Tanpa sengaja, Bastian dan Maesaroh berpelukan. Maesaroh yang merupakan gadis asli Betawi dan menyukai tanjidor karena itu adalah warisan babehnya, mengajak Bastian bergabung di grup tanjidor miliknya. Bastian pun setuju dan mau bekerja di tempat Maesaroh. Sejak saat itu, Bastian dan Maesaroh pun menjadi dekat dan lengket. Padahal, Bastian dan Maesaroh sudah dijodohkan oleh ibu mereka masing-masing dengan anak orang kaya, tapi keduanya menolak.

programme.title: The Retaliators
programme.desc: An upstanding pastor uncovers a dark and twisted underworld as he searches for answers surrounding his daughter's brutal murder.

programme.title: The Fourth State
programme.desc: A German journalist investigating the Russian secret service gets caught up in a terrorist plot in Moscow.

programme.title: The Professor And The Madman
programme.desc: The story of Professor James Murray compiling words for the first edition of the Oxford English Dictionary in the mid 19th century.

programme.title: Murder Of N. Brown Simpson
programme.desc: Inspired by true events, the film follows OJ Simpson's ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson in the last days before her tragic death on June 12th 1994, as seen from her point of view.

programme.title: Traded
programme.desc: In the 1880s western Traded, a father must leave his ranch for Dodge City to save his daughter from an old enemy, putting his reputation as the fastest draw in the west to the test.

programme.title: The Lurking Fear
programme.desc: When a TV crew shoots a reality show at an abandoned mental institution, they encounter a horde of demons, leading to a bloody fight for survival.

programme.title: Call Me King
programme.desc: In the international world of gun running loyalty, honor and discretion are valuable commodities, but nothing is more priceless than the bond of family. Power begets enemies and a loved ones betrayal cuts like a knife. Sides will be chosen, wars will be fought. In the end, there can only be one King.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away in a remote country house but when a mysterious man turns up and telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: Shock And Awe
programme.desc: A group of journalists of the Knight-Ridder covering President George W. Bush's planned invasion of Iraq in 2003 are skeptical of the President's claim that Saddam Hussein has 'weapons of mass destruction.'

programme.title: You're Not Alone
programme.desc: An evil entity begins to torment a mother and daughter, who are forced to face the inexplicable presence that inhabits the walls of their new home.

programme.title: Shut In
programme.desc: When a young mother is barricaded inside a pantry by her violent ex-boyfriend, she must use ingenuity to protect her two small children from escalating danger while finding an escape.

programme.title: Among The Shadows
programme.desc: A private investigator must unravel the murder of her uncle while keeping the secret that she is a descendant from a line of werewolves.

programme.title: Gravy
programme.desc: It's All Hallow's Eve. A trio of costumed misfits with very special dietary requirements seizes a Mexican cantina and force the staff to engage in a late night of gaming, food and libations. The only caveat is what's on the menu.

programme.title: Intruder
programme.desc: During one of Oregon's most violent storms, a young cellist seeks solitude and comfort in the safety of her large apartment, but soon realizes she might not be home alone.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: A ragtag unit of misfits known as the War Pigs must go behind enemy lines to exterminate Nazis by any means necessary.

programme.title: Burial Ground Massacre
programme.desc: A group of college students spend a night at an old, eerie manor, only to realize that a terrifying stalker is watching their every move as he begins plans to repossess an ancient Native American artifact located inside.

programme.title: Elizabeth Harvest
programme.desc: Elizabeth arrives with her brilliant scientist husband Henry to his magnificent estate. Henry explains that everything in his world now belongs to her, all except for a locked-off room he forbids her from entering.

programme.title: Operation Seawolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: While We Sleep
programme.desc: After observing a hauntingly familiar abnormal CAT scan of a 13 year old girl, radiologist Nina Evanko battles to find the source of the young girl's sleeping disorder. What she discovers is darker and stranger than she could have imagined.

programme.title: Don't Kill It
programme.desc: An ancient demon terrorizes a tiny Mississippi town.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: A farmer takes in an injured man with a satchel of cash. When a posse comes for the money, he must decide who to trust. Defending a siege, he reveals a gunslinging talent calling his true identity into question.

programme.title: Skin
programme.desc: A destitute young man, raised by racist skinheads and notorious among white supremacists, turns his back on hatred and violence to transform his life, with the help of a black activist and the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Retaliators
programme.desc: An upstanding pastor uncovers a dark and twisted underworld as he searches for answers surrounding his daughter's brutal murder.

programme.title: Crime Story
programme.desc: An old man suffering from cancer seeks revenge on the thieves who have destroyed his life.

programme.title: Stowaway
programme.desc: A tenacious party girl fights to survive after three thieves commandeer her luxury yacht. Unable to escape, she turns the tables on the intruders and takes matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Riot
programme.desc: Cop Jack Stone robs a Russian mob bank to end in the same prison as the mob boss killing Jack's wife. An inmate helps him as does a reporter. Lots of fights.

programme.title: Beneath Us
programme.desc: The American Dream becomes a nightmare for a group of undocumented day laborers hired by a wealthy couple.

programme.title: Death In Texas
programme.desc: Just out of prison, Billy Walker returns to El Paso to find his mom dying of liver failure but low on the transplant list. However, the border offers other, darker options.

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: In San Francisco, an amiable banker's seemingly perfect life is turned upside down when his deceitful fiancée embarks on an affair with his best friend.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible

Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Oddbods is an animated, slapstick comedy that embraces adventure and celebrates friendship. Following the wacky adventures of eight unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected outcomes.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Little Angel is an animated musical show for pre-schoolers. The show has been captivating families around the world with its cheeky humor and catchy upbeat songs.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: PORORO AND TAYO SONGS
programme.desc: Watch music videos for Pororo, Tayo, and their friends!

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: PINKFONG And FRIENDS
programme.desc: Each episode features a new story that is both entertaining and educational, with interactive moments that invite children to guess, sing, and share in the joy with the characters.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: In a big city where various vehicles happily coexist, the little bus Tayo has just started learning his route around town. There are many things for Tayo to learn. Tayo and his friends, Rogi, Lani, and Gani, help each other to become great grown-up buses.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: **SUNNY GIRL NO.23** is not only about the growth journey of a cheerful young girl, but also the first realistic-themed animated series that reflects parent-child education and school life in China. The main character is an 8-year-old elementary school student. She is not extraordinary. She is a clumsy girl, but also energetic, optimistic, and kind-hearted, with a talent for drawing, creativity, and problem-solving abilities that many children can relate to. This animation has been well received by audiences in Mainland China and has also been distributed across Southeast Asia, including Malaysia and Vietnam. The first season expresses a worldview through 26 humorous stories: *There are many different forms of excellence, and every child is exceptional in their own way.* It not only portrays the childhood experiences of contemporary elementary school students but also explores the clash between traditional and modern parenting concepts. The second season continues and further develops this worldview.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT NEW SEASON

FROM BUILDING BU INAH’S DREAM FOOD STALL, TO THE HILARIOUS UPS AND DOWNS OF LIVING NEXT DOOR TO CEU KOKOM, AND PAK SOMAT’S STRUGGLE TO BECOME AN ONLINE MOTORCYCLE TAXI DRIVER FOR HIS FAMILY. A HEARTWARMING STORY FULL OF LAUGHTER AND MORAL LESSONS FOR ALL AGES.

programme.desc: BEDU AND ADUL IS A 3D ANIMATED FILM SERIAL ABOUT THE ADVENTURES OF CHILDREN IN THE MULTICULTURAL SUBURBS OF JAKARTA. THEIR INQUIRIES MAKE THEM WANTED TO EXPLORE, SOMETIMES CAUSING A FUCKING FUCK.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Oddbods is an animated, slapstick comedy that embraces adventure and celebrates friendship. Following the wacky adventures of eight unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected outcomes.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Little Angel is an animated musical show for pre-schoolers. The show has been captivating families around the world with its cheeky humor and catchy upbeat songs.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: PORORO AND TAYO SONGS
programme.desc: Watch music videos for Pororo, Tayo, and their friends!

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: PINKFONG And FRIENDS
programme.desc: Each episode features a new story that is both entertaining and educational, with interactive moments that invite children to guess, sing, and share in the joy with the characters.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: In a big city where various vehicles happily coexist, the little bus Tayo has just started learning his route around town. There are many things for Tayo to learn. Tayo and his friends, Rogi, Lani, and Gani, help each other to become great grown-up buses.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.desc: One Last Thing follows Dylan Derringer, a young man diagnosed with a terminal illness who decides to make the most of the time he has remaining. Along the way, he sets out to reconnect with his estranged father, mend broken relationships, and pursue experiences he had long postponed. Through moments of humor, heartbreak, and self-reflection, Dylan discovers the importance of forgiveness, family, and living life with purpose despite the uncertainty of the future.

programme.title: Brandon Thomas-Asante : The Big Interview
programme.desc: While Coventry City have waited 25 years for their return to the top-flight, it's been a lifetime's work for Sky Blues striker Brandon Thomas-Asante. Having toiled hard in the lower leagues for a number of years, the Ghana international made his World Cup debut this summer and can now look forward to a first Premier League appearance at the home of the champions, for the opening match of the 2026/27 season.

programme.title: Coventry Rising : PL Stories
programme.desc: We follow Coventry City as they prepare for a long-awaited return to the Premier League, ending a 25-year absence from English football's top flight. With exclusive access during the club's pre-season training camp in Malaga, we go behind the scenes as players and staff build towards a landmark campaign filled with anticipation and expectation.? Alongside the preparations for the future, we reflect on the remarkable journey that has brought the Sky Blues back to the Premier League. From unforgettable highs to painful setbacks, financial turmoil to remarkable resurgence, we explore the defining moments that have shaped one of English football's most resilient clubs.

programme.desc: Eric and fellow warrior Sara, raised as members of ice Queen Freya's army, try to conceal their forbidden love as they fight to survive the wicked intentions of both Freya and her sister Ravenna.

programme.title: Godzilla Minus One (Rock Action)
programme.desc: A kamikaze pilot plagued by survivor's guilt seeks redemption when a giant monster he failed to kill is transformed by radiation from atomic bomb tests and lays siege to post-war Japan.

programme.title: Pitch Black
programme.desc: A passenger ship crash lands on a planet that has only sunlight, but an eclipse throws the survivors into danger when carnivorous monsters emerge.

programme.desc: Deckard Shaw seeks revenge against Dominic Toretto and his family for his comatose brother.

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: A scientist's drive for artificial intelligence takes on dangerous implications when his own consciousness is uploaded into one such program.

programme.title: Tin Man, Pt 1
programme.desc: A storm carries a woman to another world where she's joined by 3 strange travelers as a sorceress hunts her.

programme.title: Tin Man, Pt 2
programme.desc: Cain and Glitch rescue DG and Raw from the tower, and the group goes in search of the emerald. Meanwhile, Azkadellia plants a spy into their group so that she can use them to find the emerald for herself.

programme.title: Si Bocil Trang Quynh
programme.desc: Kisah Lucu Dan Jenaka Tentang Kehidupan Quynh Dan Orang-Orang Disekitarnya. Sebagai Anak Yang Nakal Tetapi Cerdas Dan Banyak Akal, Quynh Dan Teman-Temannya Akan Membawa Pengalaman Hidup Yang Penuh Warna Di Pedesaan Vietnam Pada Abad Ke-18. Menyoroti Juga Tentang Nilai-Nilai Budaya Rakyat Dan Hubungan Dengan Keluarga, Teman, Guru, Siswa, Dan Lingkungan. Trang Quynh Akan Membawa Tawa Bagi Penonton Dan Mengajarkan Mereka Tentang Keintiman, Persahabatan, Dan Nilai-Nilai Kemanusiaan.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop
programme.desc: Bread, Seorang Tukang Cukur Jenius, Memecahkan Masalah Penampilan Dengan Keterampilan Memotong Rambutnya Yang Briliant. Sekarang Dia Hadir Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Para Bintang Di Bakery Town. Bertentangan Dengan Penampilan Mereka Yang Glamor Dan Bersinar, Para Selebriti Ini Menjalani Hari Yang Sangat Suram. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Metal Cardbot
programme.desc: Dahulu Kala, Terdapat Sebuah Planet Bernama Machina Dimana Metal Cardbots Tinggal. Suatu Ketika, Planet Ini Tiba-Tiba Meledak Dan Memaksa Semua Penghuninya Untuk Hidup Di Bumi. Agar Tidak Menarik Perhatian Makhluk Bumi, Cardbots Menyamar Sebagai Kendaraan Sehari-Hari. Hingga Suatu Hari, Seorang Anak Sekolah Dasar Yang Bernama Jun Secara Tidak Sengaja Menemukan Metal Breath, Dengan Metal Breath Tersebut Dia Bisa Menangkap Dan Menyalakan Cardbots Dengan Kemampuan Yang Berbeda.

programme.title: Grizzy And The Lemmings

programme.title: Blox Buster
programme.desc: Blox Buster Adalah Program Entertainment Yang Menghadirkan Keseruan Bermain Di Dunia Roblox, Platform Game Populer Dengan Jutaan Kreasi Dari Komunitas Global, Penonton Diajak Menjelajahi Berbagai Dunia Virtual Yang Penuh Warna, Menantang, Sekaligus Menyenangkan. Tidak Hanya Sekadar Bermain, Main Bareng Blox Juga Menyuguhkan Pengalaman Unik Dari Para Gamers Yang Ikut Serta, Mulai Dari Review Game, Tips Seru, Hingga Momen-Momen Kejutan Yang Terjadi Saat Bermain.

programme.title: Ruang Redaksi
programme.desc: Ruang Redaksi di Sin Po TV adalah program bincang-bincang yang membawa pemirsa ke balik layar proses redaksi berita. Program ini menghadirkan jurnalis, editor, dan pengamat media untuk membahas sudut pandang, tantangan, dan etika pemberitaan. Setiap episode menggali bagaimana isu menjadi penting, verifikasi fakta, dan keputusan editorial diambil, menunjukkan kerja keras serta integritas jurnalistik. Program ini juga sering membahas tren media dan literasi digital. Dengan format santai namun informatif, Ruang Redaksi bertujuan membangun kepercayaan publik pada media dan meningkatkan pemahaman tentang peran vital jurnalisme.

programme.title: Sorotan Dunia
programme.desc: Sorotan Dunia di Sin Po TV adalah program diskusi yang menganalisis isu-isu krusial di Indonesia secara mendalam. Berbeda dari berita biasa, program ini menggali akar masalah, implikasi, dan berbagai perspektif dari para ahli. Setiap episode membahas topik utama seperti kebijakan pemerintah, politik, ekonomi, sosial, atau budaya. Dengan menghadirkan narasumber kredibel, Sorotan Utama bertujuan membantu pemirsa memahami kompleksitas isu dan membentuk opini yang terinformasi. Program ini ideal bagi siapa saja yang ingin mendapatkan pemahaman lebih dalam tentang dinamika yang memengaruhi Indonesia.
